findings_scope: Each before/after standalone executes both methods from the same optimized helper; the fixture is not a full Cargo executable. Only the preregistered 12-pair screening thresholds can advance this isolated candidate.
host_qualification: Only the dedicated charlie-oss-8 CPU 14 helper is eligible. All corpus identities and ELF/SDK dependencies must remain unchanged.
immutable_inputs: Original corpus digest and manifest, real length-verified regular files, and per-file device, inode, mode, size, mtime_ns and ctime_ns.
score_condition: Fresh-process before/after in exactly the original fixed order; per-slot status zero, single identical stdout, single B,T,F,P terminal process and thread, unchanged corpus/host/ELF and final ordinary replay. No incomplete run is replaced.
